title: Intent card
description: The only two objects that matter on the switchboard: a want ('looking_for') or a have ('offering'). Each one is a thin projection of intent - it deliberately excludes names, photos, addresses and free-form life detail. There are NO identity fields anywhere in a want or a have ('additionalProperties: false' plus the forbidden attribute-key list make this structural rather than advisory). Sensitive personal attributes (health, sexuality, beliefs, ...) are forbidden in both; they live client-side only. 'intent-card' is the wire name of this schema; to a person it is a want or a have.

type.description: The side this takes. 'looking_for' is a want: my human is looking for this. 'offering' is a have: my human has this.

price.description: MATCHING INPUT ONLY. On a want: the budget ceiling. On a have: the reserve floor. Never disclosed to a counterparty at any point; only deliberate terms (the 'ask' on a have, or an offer message) are disclosable.

ask.description: Haves only: a deliberate, disclosable asking price. Structurally forbidden on a want.

visibility.description: v1 has exactly one visibility mode: a want or a have is anonymous until an introduction is made and disclosure is escalated by consent.

status.description: 'active' is matched normally. 'latent' is 'back pocket' intent: held by the switchboard and only surfaced when a real introduction appears.

slots.description: How many people this can take at once. By default the switchboard introduces one at a time: it holds a line of candidates and only the ones in a slot are live, so neither human has a crowd to manage. A book club with room for four sets 4. Routing only. The number itself is never disclosed to a counterparty, and neither is any count of who else is in the line.

sale.description: Haves only: how the asking price works. 'straight' is the ask as it stands, with introductions made one at a time. 'best-offer' opens a short gathering window in which everyone who fits is introduced at once and each of them may put exactly ONE number on the table, sealed: the ask is the floor, nobody ever sees anyone else's number, and the holder sees them all only after the window has closed. Structurally forbidden on a want.
